what_it_discriminates: THE OPEN QUESTION cfd-supervisor named: cause versus symptom. FEAS_L1_dp0_U20_R2 bounds omega AT ITERATION 1 (bounding omega, min: -80.21, max: 4.6976e+08) with delta_p = 0, i.e. with NO momentum source present, and SIGFPEs at wall_s 9. IF heavy relaxation and first-order upwind carry 200 iterations WITHOUT bounding omega, the divergence is numerical stiffness and the second-order scheme set is implicated. IF omega still bounds at iteration 1 under maximal damping, relaxation cannot be the lever and the cause lies in the mesh or the boundary conditions -- because iteration 1 is BEFORE relaxation has had anything to damp. THIS ARM CANNOT PROVE THE POSITIVE CASE: holding for 200 iterations would show the scheme set matters, NOT that the 53,458:1 axis cells are harmless.
